results.title: All in the Lai family as paddler Yong Han takes gold for Penang
results.description: KLANG: It was a family affair in the men's singles final as Penang Lai brothers Yong Han and Yong Ren went head-to-head for the Malaysia Games (Sukma) Selangor gold medal.

results.title: Cricket-Bangladesh captain Shanto seeks more test tours to Australia after Mackay setback
results.description: Aug 23 (Reuters) - Bangladesh captain ⁠Najmul Hossain Shanto urged Australia and the game's powerbrokers to give the South Asian nation ⁠more test tours, saying it was essential for his team to gain experience in different ‌conditions to improve in the format, following their defeat in two days in Mackay.

results.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Ishan Kishan struggle as East Zone face North East Zone in Duleep Trophy opener
results.description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Ishan Kishan struggled in East Zone’s Duleep Trophy opener against North East Zone, dismissed for eight and four runs.
